title: Chicago Murder Mystery Tour
requirements: Infants and small children can ride in a pram or stroller
All areas and surfaces are wheelchair accessible
Suitable for all physical fitness levels
We do not provide wheelchairs, baby strollers, or other mobility devices
policies: This is an outdoor walking tour experience. 1.2 miles over 2 hours.
Please contact 872-310-7645 and/or info@magnificotours.com with any questions
cancellation: For a full refund, cancel at least 24 hours before the scheduled departure time.
blurb:
You will solve a murder as you learn real Chicago history! Play detective as you unravel a murder mystery, and learn about Chicago's true crime legends and Prohibition secrets. 

This two-in-one experience combines a rich historical walking tour with an exciting award-winning murder mystery game. Perfect for people looking for a history tour of Chicago, and also for people looking for a chance to play and have fun. 

Explore a City, Solve a Murder! Only on the Chicago Murder Mystery Tour.
